# Find a company page URL

Last updated: 2 years ago

LinkedIn Pages allows you to explore companies, universities, and high schools you're interested in by offering culture insights, the latest organization updates and industry news, and information about new job opportunities.

To find a company page URL:

1.  On a desktop browser, type and enter the company name into the **Search** bar at the top of your LinkedIn homepage.
    
2.  Click **Companies** at the top of the search results page. If needed, click **Locations**, **Industry**, or **Company size** to filter the results for a company.
    
3.  Select the correct organization name in the results list.
    

The Company Page URL will be displayed in your browser URL field and will resemble this format: [http://www.linkedin.com/company/a-b-c-company](http://www.linkedin.com/company/a-b-c-company) or [http://www.linkedin.com/company/a-b-c-company/mycompany](http://www.linkedin.com/company/a-b-c-company/mycompany)

**Note:** If you can’t find the company you were looking for, it's possible the organization hasn't added a Page yet.

Learn more:

*   [Create a page](https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/a543852)
